story.title: Fake Allu Arjun AI Chatbots Remain Live on CelebsGPT Despite Delhi High Court Personality Rights Order
story.summary: AI platform CelebsGPT continues to host fake chatbots mimicking actor Allu Arjun despite a Delhi High Court order granting him personality rights protection. The bots are styled as celebrity-character AI avatars and remain accessible on both the CelebsGPT site and Instagram, exposing a significant enforcement gap in India's emerging AI personality-rights jurisprudence. The case highlights the difficulty courts face in compelling removal of AI-generated impersonations from platforms with limited Indian regulatory reach.
